package.description: A free viewer for EPS files.

en-US.description: A free viewer for EPS files.
en-US.longDescription: EPS File Viewer is a free and simple file viewer for EPS (Encapsulated PostScript) format files. It can quickly open and show EPS images, provides picture zoom function, and lets you zoom-in or zoom-out. This software is designed to be intuitive, simple, and very easy to use.
en-US.name: EPS File Viewer
